issues.reason: No word predicates 'keeper' of the father — the atom rides only on the presupposition triggered by 'other', and the instruction set's standing treatment of presupposition triggers is structural recording, never top-level assertion ('Do NOT assert the additive / scalar presupposition as a fact'; 'Do not assert the presupposed prior / expected event itself'), so it fails Core patterns' point-at-the-words test.

Dropping an unencodable modifier is the licensed fallback ('carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap'), and here nothing is widened — the three companions stay a distinct group of keepers and every emitted atom stays true — so the loss of 'other' is the coverage gap the reviewer already filed, not a second defect.

gaps_confirmed: contrastive 'other' on a counted plural ('three other Keepers'): no licensed carrier for the modifier and no projection rule for the same-class presupposition it puts on the subject
defect_summary: Compliant form: the parse exactly as written but WITHOUT (Past (Member sk_father_1 keeper)); 'other' itself has no licensed carrier — the closed relational vocabulary holds no Other head and coining one is barred ('Never coin a relation head') — so the presupposition stays unencoded and is recorded as a gap.
notes: The reviewer's second gap is thin: the Name-only carve-out is explicitly for a capitalized plural label *referring as a name*, which a numeral-counted indefinite is not, so the common-noun GroupOf default the parse used is decided rather than undecided. Everything else — the Cove-Stair name+kind pair, Time/Every for 'every evening', BeforeBy on now, CoAgent for the comitative — follows the instruction set.
